set.body: Reconstruct the published pcmri probe-window catalog from the private Wynn fixation exports, audit the report's internally inconsistent prose against its rendered tables, and compare GazeWeave Replay/Transport against duration-weighted density sigma 80 and MultiMatch under a common trial window, template, nonmatch set, support, and behavioral estimand. Preserve raw and participant-linked outputs as local-only. Primary gates: reproduce density and MultiMatch signs/effect scales where metric provenance permits; quantify held-out item information and old-trial response association; use crossed participant/item uncertainty and multiplicity-aware interpretation; document any irreducible mismatch caused by undeployed metric-generation files.
set.title: GW-16 Reproduce pcmri probe-window catalog and benchmark GazeWeave
